producer_raw_inputs.note: No authority on any authorized surface establishes the raw inputs consumed by the micro_liquidity producer; the payload column proves the output surface only (principle P1).

upstream_detector_inputs.note: No authority establishes whether the micro_liquidity producer consumes outputs of other detector families; candidate upstreams inside and outside the declared subject set are equally unevidenced.

object_ids.note: The object identifier scheme for micro_liquidity objects inside the payload content is not available on authorized surfaces; only the physical column and manifest identity hashes exist.

retained_upstream_source_ids.note: No authority establishes whether micro_liquidity objects retain upstream or source identifiers inside the payload content.

occurrence_timestamps.note: Only the physical row coordinates bar_open_ts and bar_close_ts exist on the Bar surface (BG001-A02-C018); per-object occurrence semantics for micro_liquidity inside the payload content are unresolved; occurrence time is provenance, not availability.

known_availability_timestamps.note: No availability or known-at field exists on the Bar row surface (BG001-A02-C019); the known-time semantics of micro_liquidity objects are unresolved.

lifecycle_semantics.note: The micro_liquidity lifecycle semantics needed for lineage (formation, activation, invalidation, completion, termination) are unresolved; the lifecycle-first rule binds any future reconstruction (BG001-A02-C022).

duplication_repackaging.note: Surface-level duplication of payload_micro_liquidity across the seven Bar scales is authoritative (BG001-A02-C026); whether content is independently computed, shared, or repackaged within or across scales is unresolved; within-row object multiplicity is unresolved.

information_ancestry.note: The only ancestry directly evidenced for micro_liquidity is physical serialization into its own payload column on a bar row; all informational ancestry is unresolved (BG001-A02-C024).

unresolved_lineage.note: All typed lineage relations for micro_liquidity are unresolved and are recorded as relationship questions; candidate upstreams outside the declared subject set are not representable as graph nodes or pairs and remain unresolved.

claims.subject: program
claims.statement: Bar rows carry exactly two physical time coordinate fields, bar_open_ts and bar_close_ts, at every Bar scale (15s, 30s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h).

authority_evidence.supports: bar_open_ts and bar_close_ts are the only physical time coordinate fields on Bar rows.

claims.subject: program
claims.statement: No known-at, available-at, receipt-time, or other availability field exists anywhere in the Bar-row physical schema; the two time coordinate fields are the complete set of physical time fields.

authority_evidence.supports: The enumerated time coordinate fields are exactly two and the physical schema lists every column; no known-at, available-at, or receipt-time field exists.

claims.subject: program
claims.statement: The Tick source carries exactly two physical time coordinate fields, event_ts_ns and received_ts_ns; received_ts_ns is the only physical receipt-time coordinate on any authorized surface.

authority_evidence.supports: event_ts_ns and received_ts_ns are the only physical time coordinate fields on Tick events.

claims.subject: program
claims.statement: Lifecycle-first: future completion or termination of an object cannot define an earlier-state cohort; completed status may only be a later outcome or a later anchor.
